title: Network Failure Response
description: Hospital network failures affecting clinical operations
triggers: Complete network outage at clinical facilities
Wireless network failures in patient care areas
immediate_actions: Identify scope of network failure (single site vs multi-site)
Implement emergency network bypass if available
Notify clinical leadership of connectivity status
investigation_steps: Check network device status and logs
Verify ISP connectivity and circuit status
Analyze network traffic patterns for anomalies
resolution_steps: Restart failed network devices following standard procedures
Implement redundant network paths if available
Coordinate with ISP for circuit issues
Apply network configuration fixes or rollbacks
verification: Test connectivity to critical clinical systems
Verify wireless network coverage in patient areas
Test remote access for clinical staff
special_considerations: Patient care areas have highest priority for restoration
Coordinate with clinical staff for minimal disruption
Document network topology changes made during incident
